name: BACH_0188_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (89%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged low reliability (30%) on a resampled frozen section prevents excluding Invasive carcinoma (6% risk; tier 1).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 89%, Invasive 6%, Normal 4%, Benign 1% [F1] | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate InSitu from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged, AUROC 70%); 100% OOD (12 regions) [F6] | Suspect degraded input; out-of-distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 40% match InSitu (2/5 InSitu, 2 Normal, 1 Benign) [F5] | Weak reference neighbor consensus |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.09, contribution -0.62) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable concept (0/20 AI check); +0.37 score not trustworthy [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Typical score (0.82, contribution -0.23); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 5) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.22, contribution -0.21) favors duct-confined growth · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top-3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Not shown faithful (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20 AI check).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section degradation (severity 3) masks stromal invasion in highest-risk regions 9 (49% risk) and 7 (30% risk).
- Out-of-distribution artifacts (100th percentile) distort calibration (5% dataset ECE, n=132) or deferred margin scores (up to 99%) [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 7**: Inspect highest-risk areas (49%, 30% invasive risk) to exclude stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 5**: Verify duct confinement and review drafted orders for recut H&E and deeper levels.
3. **Regions 9, 11**: Defer frozen margin call to permanents despite 99% inferior and lateral edge scores.
